From 56.8 °C to 48.7 °C
in sixty seconds

Drawn entirely from the project's own analysis — no photographs. The arc, the 131 trees, the eighteen rooms and the plan-form sweep are read out of src/plan.py and the solar model at build time. The centre of the film is the sweep: seven plan forms tested against 8,760 hours of real sun, scored, and the one adopted on the measure that mattered.
